error_codes.meaning: Indoor coil fault and sensor fault
Indoor and outdoor machine communication fault
Outdoor unit over-high/over-low AC voltage protection
DC voltage over-high or over-low voltage protection
Cooling outdoor ambient temperature over-low protection
Heating outdoor ambient temperature over-high protection

steps.instruction: Fault codes will show on display board once occur. Protection codes will not show on the display board directly. But customer can check these protection codes by pressing the "WIFI" / "ADJ" button 8 times in 10 seconds constantly. If there no protection is activated, "00" exhibits on the display board.
steps.summary_en: Check protection codes by pressing WIFI or ADJ eight times within ten seconds.

steps.instruction: For Wi-Fi Model E9 Error (Wi-Fi Module Fault) can be seen while pressing the Emergency switch & power ON the IDU (Test Mode)
steps.summary_en: Enter Test Mode by pressing the Emergency switch while powering ON the indoor unit to check for Wi-Fi module errors.

warnings: DUE TO HIGH VOLTAGE, DO NOT TOUCH THE TERMINALS IN THE CONTROL BOARD DURING OPERATION AND 5 MINUTES AFTER SWITCHING OFF. NEXT, CONFIRM THE VOLTAGE RECTIFICATION CIRCUIT BETWEEN DIODE BRIDGE (+) AND (-) HAS DROPPED TO BELOW 42V, BEFORE ACCESSING TO THE TERMINALS IN THE CONTROL BOARD.
NOTE- 1. THE WIRING DIAGRAM IS ONLY FOR EXPLANATION PURPOSE. 2. THE ACTUAL SHAPE OF COMPONENT AND PCB MAY BE DIFFERENT.

steps.instruction: Check to make sure that the voltage between (+) and (–) of the power module is approx. 0 V before checking.
steps.summary_en: Check to make sure that the voltage between (+) and (–) of the power module is approx. 0 V before checking.

steps.instruction: Discharge the capacitor completely before conducting repair work.
steps.summary_en: Discharge the capacitor completely before conducting repair work.

steps.instruction: Check the load condition. (Refrigerant, Pipe length, Blocked, ...)
steps.summary_en: Check the load condition. (Refrigerant, Pipe length, Blocked, ...)
